Buffalo Wild Wings Happy Hour: Must-Try Menu Items and Deals

Buffalo Wild Wings is renowned for its vibrant atmosphere, extensive menu, and exciting happy hour specials. Whether you’re a fan of wings, beer, or simply a great deal, their happy hour is a must-experience event. This guide will walk you through everything you need to know about Buffalo Wild Wings’ happy hour, including the best menu items, deals, and how you can make the most of your visit.

What is Buffalo Wild Wings Happy Hour?

Buffalo Wild Wings offers a fantastic happy hour that is perfect for unwinding after a long day. During this special time, you can enjoy discounted menu items, beverages, and more. The happy hour typically runs from 3 PM to 6 PM, with some locations offering late-night happy hour deals.

Buffalo Wild Wings Happy Hour Timing

 

Happy Hour Type Timing
Regular Happy Hour 3 PM – 6 PM
Late Night Happy Hour 9 PM – Close

 

Why You Should Visit During Happy Hour

Buffalo Wild Wings’ happy hour is the ultimate time to enjoy their extensive menu at a reduced price. Whether you’re looking to catch up with friends, watch a game, or just enjoy some great food and drinks, happy hour at BWW is the perfect choice. The combination of sports, wings, and drink specials creates an unparalleled experience.

During happy hour, Buffalo Wild Wings offers a variety of specials on both food and drinks. Here’s a detailed look at what you can expect:

Must-Try Menu Items During Happy Hour

Buffalo Wild Wings’ menu is packed with options, but there are some standout items that you should definitely try during happy hour:

1. Traditional Wings

Buffalo Wild Wings is famous for its wings, and during happy hour, you can enjoy them at an incredible price. Choose from a variety of flavors such as Buffalo, BBQ, and Asian Zing. Pair them with a cold beer for the ultimate experience.

2. Boneless Wings

If you prefer a mess-free option, the boneless wings are a great choice. They come in the same delicious flavors as the traditional wings and are perfect for dipping in your favorite sauces.

3. Pretzel Knots

These soft pretzel knots are served with a warm beer cheese dip, making them a great snack to enjoy with your drinks. They’re also a fantastic shareable option for groups.

4. Chips and Salsa

A light and refreshing option, the chips and salsa are perfect for munching on while you enjoy your drink. The salsa is made fresh and pairs perfectly with the crispy tortilla chips.

5. Wild Herd Kölsch by Goose Island

For beer lovers, the Wild Herd Kölsch by Goose Island is a must-try. It’s a crisp and refreshing beer that complements the flavors of the wings and other menu items.

How to Maximize Your Buffalo Wild Wings Happy Hour Experience

Arrive Early

To make the most of the happy hour specials, try to arrive early. The best deals are available during the first hour of happy hour, and arriving early ensures you get a table and don’t miss out on the specials.

Check Local Buffalo Wild Wings Deals

Each Buffalo Wild Wings location may offer slightly different specials and deals. Check the nearest Buffalo Wild Wings for their specific happy hour deals to ensure you’re getting the best offers.

Try the Drink Specials

Happy hour isn’t just about the food; the drink specials are equally important. Take advantage of discounted beers and cocktails to enhance your experience.

Share with Friends

Buffalo Wild Wings’ happy hour is a social event. Sharing the menu items with friends can make the experience even more enjoyable and allow you to try a wider variety of items.

Keep an Eye on the TVs

Buffalo Wild Wings is known for its sports atmosphere. Enjoy the games on their numerous TVs while you savor your happy hour deals. It’s the perfect way to combine food, drinks, and sports.

Buffalo Wild Wings Happy Hour Locations

Buffalo Wild Wings has numerous locations across the country, each offering a unique happy hour experience. Here’s how to find the nearest Buffalo Wild Wings:

How to Locate a Buffalo Wild Wings Near You

  1. Visit the Official Website: Use the restaurant locator tool to find the nearest Buffalo Wild Wings.
  2. Use Google Maps: Search for Buffalo Wild Wings in your area to see the nearest locations and their hours.
  3. Call Ahead: If you’re looking for specific happy hour deals, calling ahead can ensure you get the information you need.

Tips for Enjoying Late Night Happy Hour

Buffalo Wild Wings’ late night happy hour provides an additional opportunity to enjoy their specials. Here are some tips for making the most of this time:

Late Night Menu

The late night happy hour menu may differ from the regular happy hour menu. Check the specific items available during this time and take advantage of the deals.

Late Night Deals

Enjoy reduced prices on select menu items and drinks during the late night happy hour. This is a great time to enjoy Buffalo Wild Wings’ offerings after dinner.

Plan Ahead

Since late night happy hour can be busy, consider planning your visit in advance. Arriving early can help you secure a table and avoid long wait times.

FAQs About Buffalo Wild Wings Happy Hour

What Are the Regular Happy Hour Hours?

Buffalo Wild Wings typically offers happy hour from 3 PM to 6 PM. Some locations may extend this time or offer additional late night happy hour specials.

What Are the Best Items to Order During Happy Hour?

Some of the best items to order include traditional wings, boneless wings, pretzel knots, and chips and salsa. Don’t forget to try the drink specials like the Wild Herd Kölsch by Goose Island.

Can I Order Delivery During Happy Hour?

Many Buffalo Wild Wings locations offer delivery services. Check with your local restaurant to see if you can order delivery or pick up during happy hour.

Are There Any Specials for Sports Events?

Buffalo Wild Wings often has special deals for major sports events. Check the schedule of upcoming games and inquire about any additional happy hour specials during these times.

Conclusion

Buffalo Wild Wings’ happy hour is the perfect opportunity to enjoy delicious food and drinks at a discounted price. With a variety of menu items, drink specials, and a lively atmosphere, it’s an experience you won’t want to miss. Whether you’re stopping by for a quick bite or settling in for a night of sports and socializing, Buffalo Wild Wings has something for everyone. Be sure to check out the nearest location and take advantage of their happy hour deals to make the most of your visit.
